column1: # Echolocation — Tier 1 site-level truth set
# Phenotype: laryngeal echolocation — echolocating bats (Yangochiroptera +
# Rhinolophoidea) + toothed whales (Odontoceti) vs non-echolocating relatives.
# Fixture: validation/fixtures/tier1/echolocation/ (Parker et al. 2013 /
# Thomas & Hahn 2015 alignments, ~22 mammals).
# The one gene with function-altering convergent sites demonstrated by
# heterologous expression + electrophysiology is prestin (SLC26A5), the outer
# hair cell motor protein:
#   Liu et al. 2014, MBE 31:2415 — "Parallel sites implicate functional
#   convergence of the hearing gene prestin among echolocating mammals":
#     N7T   -> convergent increase in 1/alpha in ALL echolocating mammals
#     I384T -> convergent V1/2 shift shared by toothed whales + CF (rhinolophoid)
#              bats
#   both parameters correlate with high-frequency hearing.
# Numbering: prestin / SLC26A5 protein, as used by Liu et al. 2010/2014
#   (Curr Biol 20:R55 / MBE 31:2415). `ref_seq` = the SLC26A5 row / consensus in
#   the fixture alignment; map with truthset.map_site_to_alignment if the fixture
#   alignment column != position.
# tier: mutagenesis = heterologous-expression functional assay (Liu 2014)
# TODO: confirm N7 / I384 land on the expected alignment columns once the fixture
#   is built; add TMC1 pore-domain convergent site (Sadanandan et al. 2023) if it
#   is in the Parker gene set.
